verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Reusable Agent Configurations, which persist an agent block under a UUID, and parallel A/B testing of configurations. Neither is documented as versioning with history, a review or approval workflow, or a rollback mechanism. Switching between stored config UUIDs would be a user-side workaround next to the story, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
